mapper.select: SELECT id FROM app_user WHERE id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT user_id, character_id, bubble_json, reading_json, reply_format_json, revision FROM app_user_chat_preference WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND character_id = #{characterId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_user_chat_preference p JOIN app_character c ON c.id = p.character_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.character_id > 0 AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND ( ( (c.owner_user_id IS NOT NULL OR c.private_card = 1) AND c.owner_user_id = #{userId} ) OR ( c.owner_user_id IS NULL AND c.private_card = 0 AND c.client_visible = 1 AND COALESCE(NULLIF(c.review_status, ''), 'APPROVED') = 'APPROVED' ) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_user_chat_preference (user_id, character_id, bubble_json, reading_json, reply_format_json, revision) VALUES (#{userId}, #{characterId}, #{bubbleJson}, #{readingJson}, #{replyFormatJson}, 1)
